abstract: BACKGROUND: Cases of malignant ovarian tumor composed of müllerian-type epithelial tumor and malignant germ cell tumor are extremely rare. CASE: We herein report the case of a 34-year-old woman with an ovarian tumor which was composed of endometrioid adenocarcinoma (EAC), clear cell adenocarcinoma (CCC), squamous cell carcinoma, yolk sac tumor (YST) and immature teratoma with prominent neuroectodermal and rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation. Even after systemic chemotherapy, this intriguing tumor recurred again and again, which is in contrast to pure germ cell tumor which is known to be sensitive to chemotherapy. CONCLUSION: No previous cases with an identical composition have been found in the literature. Correct diagnosis of this complex and aggressive tumor is paramount.
abstract_ja: 背景：ミュラー管型上皮性腫瘍と悪性胚細胞腫瘍からなる悪性卵巣腫瘍はきわめてまれである。症例：34歳女性の卵巣腫瘍で、類内膜腺癌、明細胞腺癌、扁平上皮癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、そして神経外胚葉および横紋筋肉腫様分化が顕著な未熟奇形腫からなっていた。全身化学療法後も本腫瘍は再発を繰り返したが、これは化学療法に感受性の高い純粋な胚細胞腫瘍とは対照的である。結論：同一組成の既報例は文献上見あたらない。この複雑で侵襲性の高い腫瘍の正確な診断はきわめて重要である。
